claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Lapatinib at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen because its reversible ATP-competitive EGFR/ERBB2 inhibition is predominantly cytostatic and requires oncogene-addicted HER2-amplified or EGFR-mutant contexts that are rare among unselected cell lines.
